text: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France. It was completed in 1889. The tower is 330 metres tall and was designed by Gustave Eiffel.

images.caption: A photograph of the Eiffel Tower in Paris at sunset.

text: The Great Wall of China stretches over 21,000 kilometres. It was built across many dynasties over two thousand years.

images.caption: An aerial photo of the Great Wall of China.

text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth. It is located in the Himalayas and reaches 8,848 metres above sea level.

images.caption: A photo of Mount Everest covered in snow.

text: Marie Curie was a physicist and chemist. She won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903 and in Chemistry in 1911. She was born in Warsaw, Poland.
The Amazon River flows through South America. It is about 6,400 kilometres long and carries more water than any other river.

images.caption: A satellite image of the Amazon River.
